breakdown.description: The orthotropic stiffness is rotated by -30 degrees instead of the specified +30 degrees
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the incorrect rotation angle. The original prompt specified a rotation of -30 degrees, which was the error. The ground truth corrected this to +30 degrees. The agent's generated specification repeated the error, stating: 'Rotate the stiffness matrix [Q] by -30 degrees'.
